name: Mystic Maze
desc: Allow me to lead you onto the endless pathways of time.

name: Immersive Theatre
desc: Spectator or protagonist — the choice is yours. Step into the fray, where courage faces towering foes... and victory awaits.
rule:
<Title>About Immersive Theatre</>
1. Immersive Theatre is divided into three sections: [Classic Repertoire], [Featured Repertoire], and [Immortal Repertoire]. Complete each section to unlock the next.
[Classic Repertoire] are one-time challenges. [Featured Repertoire] and [Immortal Repertoire] rotate with version updates. [Immortal Repertoire] also include permanent stages that can be replayed after meeting certain conditions.
2. Defeat all opponents within the time limit to clear a stage. Completing a stage awards [Stars] and [Ticket Stubs]. Stars unlock milestone rewards. Ticket Stubs can be exchanged for items at the Theatre Gift Shop.
3. [Classic Repertoire] and [Featured Repertoire] include two rounds per stage: [Hero's Odyssey] and [Hero's Way Home]. You must use different teams for each round. Final rewards are based on your total stars earned across both rounds. [Immortal Repertoire] includes only [Hero's Odyssey].
4. Each round consists of 5 rooms that must be cleared in order. Clear all rooms in both [Hero's Odyssey] and [Hero's Way Home] to unlock the next act. Failing to defeat the opponent or running out of time in any room will prevent further progress.
5. All stages feature [Stage Score] — a unique mechanic that grants buffs or debuffs during battle. You can adjust your strategy based on the effects in play.

name: Voyage into the Long Night
desc: Complete the Main Story "Prey VS Hunter" to claim your Quest Rewards, including the [Thought: Outsider].

name: Step into the Rainveil
desc: Complete the Main Story "The Overlookers" to claim your Quest Rewards, including the [Thought: Daphne].

name: Stranger from Afar
desc: The merchant Zhiliu from Huaxu, whom you crossed paths with before, has settled briefly in The Asphodel. As a proven Phoxhunter, you've been recommended to help her get ready. Gather what she needs and earn generous rewards.

name: Friendly Games
desc:
"H—H—Hey, wait, WAIT! Let's settle this nice and civil for once, alright!? Like... with a wager! Beat my little challenge and the loot's all yours!"
  
— Lulu Lunoloot, curled up on the ground, begging for mercy
rule:
1. Complete Regular Games curated by Lulu Lunoloot to earn Luno Points.
 At each daily server reset, your Luno Collections are calculated based on your Luno Points. Any excess beyond the cap will be converted into Coins at a fixed rate.
 2. <highlight>Four</> Daily Games refresh with each daily server reset. After settling the previous day's Luno Collection, new Daily Games will unlock. Repeatable Games can be completed multiple times and do not reset daily.
 3. Complete Challenge Games to earn Challenge Points, which can be exchanged for Lulu Lunoloot's Challenge Collections.
 4. Challenge Games are released in <highlight>two</> phases. Lulu Lunoloot will unveil the next batch of her hard-crafted Games 5 days after the event starts.

name: Roaring Drills
desc: Precision gunnery training — a trial by fire. Aim, fire, and complete every objective to prove your mettle.

name: Guiding Luno
desc: Follow me to stay on course and claim awesome rewards!

name: A Rainbow-coloured Dream
desc:
When a young nightingale leaves its nest, it sees the vast skies and sweeps across soft meadows — but also faces cold rain and raging winds.
 But the girl has made up her mind: no more turning back. With her magic brush, she'll paint a dream in every hue — and in this harsh, unforgiving world... find a sky forever warm and bright, just like the ones in her favourite fairytales.

name: Luno's Special Theatre
desc:
The Silvercandle Carnival wrapped up in a chain of unexpected twists, casting yet another shadow over Icelake.
In this moment of uncertainty, the self-proclaimed "Demon King of Light" burst onto the scene!
rule:
<H>Luno's Special Theatre Event Rules</>
1. After completing the quest "Luno's Special Theatre", you can sign up for the event with Director Putsch at <H>Galea Theater</>.
2. In <H>Lunoball</>, follow Luno's instructions on the stage and display the matching <H>Geniemon</> and <H>posture</> to receive rewards. To meet the requirement, you can simply display the same type of Geniemon. Release the skill of Miraculous Bro Boxie to meet the requirement of <H>Shiny Bro Boxie</> and <H>Ardent Bro Boxie</>.
3. If you meet one or more requirements in each <H>Lunoball</>, you can get <H>premium rewards</> at the end of the ball. Each account can get <H>Premium Rewards</> <H>5</> times at most during the event period, and after that, even if more reqirements are met, only <H>regular rewards</> will be granted. The interval between two <H>Lunoballs</> is half an hour.
4. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, rewards will be sent via mail after a certain progress of delivering materials.
5. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, clicking [Auto-Add] will automatically add deliverable materials according to the quality of the materials.
6. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, the [Auto-Add] function becomes unavailable once all delivery milestones are complete. You can still manually add and deliver materials to finish quests and claim rewards.

name: Great Chaos of Mechapuppets
desc: For as long as anyone can remember, people have argued themselves hoarse over who's stronger — even when they're from completely different worlds. Thanks to Master Gongshang, you can finally stop bickering and settle it on the board. Deploy the mechapuppets, and let the outcome speak for itself.
rule:
1. In Great Chaos of Mechapuppets, you need to strategically equip Runes and deploy Mechapuppets to clear boards. Complete Board Insights to earn generous rewards.
2. Master Gongshang's Boards will open over time. Clearing a board unlocks new Mechapuppets and Runes in Board Insights. Clearing specific boards also raises your Rank cap.
3. Clear Endless Games to earn Match Points. Accumulating points increases your Rank. Each Rank up also grants rewards via Board Insights and unlocks more challenging Endless Games for greater clearance rewards. Endless Games can be refreshed 5 times a day.
4. Completing Board Insights unlocks more powerful Mechapuppets and Runes, aiding you in clearing harder boards. Visit the Board Insights interface to view all available objectives.
5. This season of Great Chaos of Mechapuppets features 9 Ranks in total. They are: 
Measured Moves
Opening Plays
Midgame Clash
Inspired Plays
Relentless Advance
Masterful Control
Beyond the Board
Grand Master

rule:
1. During the event, you will receive 2 Starglow Gifts each day. Each Gift requires 3 Starglow Coins to open.

name: Fading Echoes Adrift
desc: During the event, you can obtain skins from the [Whispers Unspoken] series and other skin rewards.
rule:
1. This event features 2 rounds, each containing 8 rewards. One of these rewards is the featured skin. Once you obtain the featured skin in a round, you will immediately receive all remaining rewards from that round.
2. Before making your first weave in a round, you can freely adjust the featured skin and the selected rewards for that round. Once you have made a weave in that round, you will no longer be able to change the featured skin or selected rewards.
3. Rewards within the same round will not be obtained more than once. As the number of remaining rewards decreases, the probability of obtaining each remaining reward increases proportionally. After completing a round, the reward probabilities reset to their initial values.
4. The initial probabilities for each reward are as follows:
[Character Skin]: 0.08%
[Helix Leap Effect]: 0.92%
[Upper-Backpiece]: 1%
[Headpiece]: 2%
[Avatar Frame]: 13%
[Avatar]: 13%
[Iridescent Dye ×3]: 35%
[Commission Manual: Volume Ⅲ ×6]: 35%
5. The number of Starweave Threads consumed per weave increases with the number of weaves made. After completing a round, the consumption amount resets to its initial value.
Starweave Threads required per weave:
1st weave: Starweave Thread ×1
2nd weave: Starweave Thread ×3
3rd weave: Starweave Thread ×6
4th weave: Starweave Thread ×10
5th weave: Starweave Thread ×15
6th weave: Starweave Thread ×20
7th weave: Starweave Thread ×25
8th weave: Starweave Thread ×30

name: Golden Journey: Geniemon Derby
desc: To Eisenbahn, time is everything. For the glory of Bloomfield Station, every employee is expected to keep pushing for greater speed — their Geniemons included.
rule:
<H>Golden Journey: Geniemon Derby Event Rules</>

1. Once the event begins, the Prediction Phase runs daily from 05:00 to 20:00. During this time, you can select up to 6 racers to support via the event interface and submit Geniemon Medals as backing. You may change your chosen racers during this phase; submitted medals cannot be withdrawn, only added to.
2. During the Prediction Phase, you can check each racer's status. Their starting speed for the day is determined by their base speed combined with their daily condition. You can spend Geniemon Medals to gather intel on racers' status.
3. The Results Sync Phase runs from 20:00 to 20:30. During this time, you cannot change your selected racers or submit additional medals.
4. The Results Phase runs from 20:30 to 05:00 the each day. During this time, you can visit the race venue, view the results, and claim your prediction rewards.
5. If you did not select any racers or submit medals during the Prediction Phase, you will only be able to view the results and will not be able to claim prediction rewards.
6. Prediction rewards must be claimed before 05:00 the following day. Please claim them in time.

name: Phoxhunter Summit
desc:
Competition is etched into the very bones of humanity — the primal drive that has pushed our kind to grow, thrive, and endure.
But this is not the law of the jungle. This is disciplined rivalry — the fire that fuels a team, and the forge where legends are made.
rule:
Event Rules:
1. The Phoxhunter Summit is divided into two phases: the Group Stage (Preliminaries) and Apex Rankings (Finals). The event begins with the Group Stage.
2. In the Group Stage, your Phoxhunter Team earns points based on battle performance. Your highest score determines your group placement. Rewards are distributed based on group placement when the stage ends, so be sure to claim them on the event page. The Apex Rankings phase begins immediately afterwards.
3. In the Apex Rankings phase, your team earns Ranking Points based on performance in each stage. Your highest Ranking Point total determines your placement within the group. Each Apex Rankings attempt consumes a Team Pass and awards a set amount of Phoxcoins according to the Ranking Points gained.
4. Phoxcoins can be exchanged for items in the Apex Shop. Certain items unlock based on your highest Ranking Point total in the Apex Rankings phase.
5. Teams that skip the Group Stage will not be placed in a group or appear in group rankings during the Apex Rankings. However, they may still challenge Apex Rankings stages to earn Phoxcoins and exchange them in the Apex Shop, including for items unlocked by reaching higher Ranking Point milestones.
 
Stage Rules:
1. In Group Stage challenges, defeat the required number of enemies within the time limit to clear the stage.
2. In Apex Rankings challenges, defeating standard enemies also deals bonus damage to the extreme-threat enemy. Clear the stage by defeating the extreme-threat enemy within the time limit.
3. You'll earn bonus points based on remaining time in both Group Stage and Apex Rankings challenges.
4. If you fail to clear the stage, you will still earn points based on your progress when the time runs out.

name: Friendly Games
desc:
"H—H—Hey, wait, WAIT! Let's settle this nice and civil for once, alright!? Like... with a wager! Beat my little challenge and the loot's all yours!"
  
— Lulu Lunoloot, curled up on the ground, begging for mercy
rule:
1. Complete Regular Games curated by Lulu Lunoloot to earn Luno Points.
 At each daily server reset, your Luno Collections are calculated based on your Luno Points. Any excess beyond the cap will be converted into Coins at a fixed rate.
 2. <highlight>Four</> Daily Games refresh with each daily server reset. After settling the previous day's Luno Collection, new Daily Games will unlock. Repeatable Games can be completed multiple times and do not reset daily.
 3. Complete Challenge Games to earn Challenge Points, which can be exchanged for Lulu Lunoloot's Challenge Collections.
 4. Challenge Games are released in <highlight>two</> phases. Lulu Lunoloot will unveil the next batch of her hard-crafted Games 5 days after the event starts.

name: Luno's Rail Rumpus
desc: Lunotoot wants everyone to see how fun railways can be! So she mimicked the fun Lunos' once had at Galea Theater, hopping and cheering in Forecourt Rotunda.
rule:
<H>Luno's Rail Rumpus Event Rules</>
1. After the event starts, you can sign up for the event with <H>Lunotoot</> at <H>Bloomfield Station</>.
2. In <H>Lunoball</>, follow Luno's instructions on the stage and display the matching <H>Geniemon</> and <H>posture</> to receive rewards. To meet the requirement, you can simply display the same type of Geniemon. Release the skill of Miraculous Bro Boxie to meet the requirement of <H>Shiny Bro Boxie</> and <H>Ardent Bro Boxie</>.
3. If you meet one or more requirements in each <H>Lunoball</>, you can get <H>premium rewards</> at the end of the ball. Each account can get <H>Premium Rewards</> <H>5</> times at most during the event period, and after that, even if more reqirements are met, only <H>regular rewards</> will be granted. The interval between two <H>Lunoballs</> is half an hour.
4. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, rewards will be sent via mail after a certain progress of delivering materials.
5. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, clicking [Auto-Add] will automatically add deliverable materials according to the quality of the materials.
6. In <H>Festive Gathering: Bloomfield Station</>, the [Auto-Add] function becomes unavailable once all delivery milestones are complete. You can still manually add and deliver materials to finish quests and claim rewards.

name: Great Chaos of Mechapuppets
desc: For as long as anyone can remember, people have argued themselves hoarse over who's stronger — even when they're from completely different worlds. Thanks to Master Gongshang, you can finally stop bickering and settle it on the board. Deploy the mechapuppets, and let the outcome speak for itself.
rule:
1. In Great Chaos of Mechapuppets, you need to strategically equip Runes and deploy Mechapuppets to clear boards. Complete Board Insights to earn generous rewards.
2. Master Gongshang's Boards will open over time. Clearing a board unlocks new Mechapuppets and Runes in Board Insights. Clearing specific boards also raises your Rank cap.
3. Clear Endless Games to earn Match Points. Accumulating points increases your Rank. Each Rank up also grants rewards via Board Insights and unlocks more challenging Endless Games for greater clearance rewards. Endless Games can be refreshed 5 times a day.
4.You can customise your lineup for Endless Game challenges and take on more formidable boards.
5. Completing Board Insights unlocks more powerful Mechapuppets and Runes, aiding you in clearing harder boards. Visit the Board Insights interface to view all available objectives.
6. After unlocking a variety of Mechapuppets, Runes, and match challenges, you can build your own powerful lineup and challenge other Phoxhunters via match invitations.
7. This season of Great Chaos of Mechapuppets features 9 Ranks in total. They are: 
First Steps
Measured Moves
Opening Plays
Midgame Clash
Inspired Plays
Relentless Advance
Masterful Control
Beyond the Board
Grand Master

name: Starry Gleanings
desc: Complete commissions during the event to claim rewards
rule:
1. During the event, you will receive 2 Starglow Gifts each day. Each Gift requires 3 Starglow Coins to open.
2. Complete Commissions to earn Starglow Coins. They can be used to open Starglow Gifts or exchanged for various rewards in the Starglow Shop.

name: Starry Gleanings Ⅱ
desc: Complete quests during the event to claim rewards
rule:
1. During the event, you will receive 2 Starglow Gifts each day. Use 3 Starglow Coins to open each gift.
2. Complete quests to earn Starglow Coins. They can be used to open Starglow Gifts or exchanged for various rewards in the Starglow Shop.
3. Open up to 16 Starglow Gifts to claim Prismatic Hourglasses, Phoxene, Starweave Thread, Starglint, and all cosmetic rewards.

name: Resonant Orisons
desc: During the event, you can obtain skins from the [Seven-Day Covenant] series and other skin rewards.
rule:
1. This event features 2 rounds, each containing 8 rewards. One of these rewards is the featured skin. Once you obtain the featured skin in a round, you will immediately receive all remaining rewards from that round.
2. Before making your first weave in a round, you can freely adjust the featured skin and the selected rewards for that round. Once you have made a weave in that round, you will no longer be able to change the featured skin or selected rewards.
3. Rewards within the same round will not be obtained more than once. As the number of remaining rewards decreases, the probability of obtaining each remaining reward increases proportionally. After completing a round, the reward probabilities reset to their initial values.
4. The initial probabilities for each reward are as follows:
[Character Skin]: 0.08%
[Helix Leap Effect]: 0.92%
[Lower-Backpiece]: 1%
[Facepiece]: 2%
[Avatar Frame]: 13%
[Avatar]: 13%
[Iridescent Dye ×3]: 35%
[Commission Manual: Volume Ⅲ ×6]: 35%
5. The number of Starweave Threads consumed per weave increases with the number of weaves made. After completing a round, the consumption amount resets to its initial value.
Starweave Threads required per weave:
1st weave: Starweave Thread ×1
2nd weave: Starweave Thread ×3
3rd weave: Starweave Thread ×6
4th weave: Starweave Thread ×10
5th weave: Starweave Thread ×15
6th weave: Starweave Thread ×20
7th weave: Starweave Thread ×25
8th weave: Starweave Thread ×30

name: Bountiful Day
desc: During the event, Demon Wedge drop rates are increased in Noctoyager Manual commissions. Limited-time Demon Wedge commissions are also available.
rule:
1. During the event, Noctoyager Manual Commissions grant extra Demon Wedges (up to <highlight>6</> times daily). This stacks with the Manual's base bonus. Complete a Commission while the boost is active to earn more Demon Wedges.
2. Logging in each day grants <highlight>1</> attempt for Limited-Time Demon Wedge Commissions. Attempts do not carry over and reset at the daily server reset. Each Demon Wedge Commission in the Noctoyager Manual has a Limited-Time variant, where Primanders appear in large numbers.
3. The challenging times and reward bonus cannot be stacked to the next day.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
No herb may cure the world's deep-rooted ills,
but hers is a nature tempered in healer's grove.
Her form shimmers, a haze amidst herbal warmth,
each elegant stroke of her prescription a quiet salve to life's impermanence.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
You met her beneath a sliver of tiny starry sky.
With fairytales, she rewrote the scars of yesterday.
Her snow-white quill lofted myriad tender dreams — 
Unbound, they ride the wind over walls, wastes, and the chill of night.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
Born of the wild grass, I wander where the wind blows.
I flick my blade to keep its tassel clean, yet dusk still gathers as it goes.
Old rules blow on the wind — what hero bows to those?
The moon never stays full; what fate ever stays its course?
So let the wild song rise again — for this I know: I stand as I choose!

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
The coin rises as Proprietress Zhiliu places her wager.
The coin falls as the High Chancellor of Loongyuan calls the outcome.
In that narrow inch between heads and tails,
her gaze slips through the hollow center—
reading the past where human nature hides,
and glimpsing the future where the world may overturn.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
Shadowed by solitude and burdened with judgment, the Magistrate of Yingtian walks the endless plains ruled by fate.
His only companions: today's duty and the flute of bygone days.
The old melody drifts through the wind, carrying his doubts away — yet never truly erasing them.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
"A fish should not be confined to a pond; a bird belongs in the open sky."

Burdened by an unfinished dream, and by the blood debts, tears, and irreconcilable grievances bound up with it, the fledgling stakes everything on a desperate gamble, struggling to break free from the past and press on towards the future she longs for.

Good night to all regrets and resentments.
Good night to the age destined to perish.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
Welcome. The Asphodel welcomes all who drift this way — even so-called "mediocrities".
Here, everything you crave can be had for the right price: fine liquor, information, treasures, discreet favours... even a path to "freedom".
Go on — tell the tavernkeeper you'll accept her request. You know she's about to make you an offer you can't refuse.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
You met her in the northern land of iron and snow.
She hides her uncertainty behind her pride,
As she pursues a hidden treasure and buries her unrest deep inside.
Before those spotless hands are stained with blood, she swears a vow of life and death.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
When the banquet stills, and the chandelier spills its alluring light...
The maid gathers her skirts and sinks into a graceful curtsy: only then does the revel truly begin.
Let the bullets sing until all falls silent; let the masks whirl until they drop.
Do not fret over the mess. After all, leaving not a speck behind is a maid's virtue.

name: Traces in the Sand
desc:
She rises on her toes and turns, a dance with a guest in white, here in the paradise.
"Wanderer, don't leave yet. Let these happy days stretch a little longer."
She hums with her eyes closed, bidding farewell to the white carousel, here in the paradise.
"White horse, stop for a while. Let me wake from this long, drowsy day."

name: When Dreams Gild the Night
desc: Midsummer night, beneath a sky of stars, a forest where violets and butterfly wings waltzed in delicate steps. A sight she had never seen.

name: When Dreams Gild the Night
desc: A murmur of love through the silks, an eternity sealed in a fatal kiss.

name: When Dreams Gild the Night
desc: Sunshine gathered, sunshine scattered!

name: Gleam of Flowing Waters
desc: Tides to wash away the dust, waves to still the heart.

name: Across Silent Mountains, Along Flowing Rivers
desc: Over wine and words, fates are drawn and fortunes unfold.

name: Azure Reverie
desc: Full charge — take flight!

name: To the Distant Shore
desc: Through a sea of thorns, towards the light.

name: Dance with the Sea
desc: Hand in hand, we dance — and seal this moment into eternity.

name: Snowveil Fairytale
desc: Snow gathers on silent shoulders, as the tale begins to wake.
